<div class="card-body">
'''Chewie''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">チューイー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。ただし場に敵の単一（＊）キャラクターが3名以上いる場合、配置することができない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Chewie-Encyclopedia32-p45.jpeg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ハン・ソロ船長の忠実なウーキーの相棒。ミレニアム・ファルコンの副操縦士。レイアいわく “歩き回るカーペット”。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Chewie.

'''Card text:'''
Deploys only on Hoth. After that, he can move anywhere. However, he cannot deploy if three or more of the opponent’s unique (*) characters are on the table.

'''Lore:'''
Captain Han Solo’s loyal Wookiee companion. Co-pilot of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Leia calls him a “walking carpet.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card uses an asterisk for the uniqueness mark in the title and the corresponding reference in the game text.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Chewie]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
